description: Human-labeled golden set for the /api/classify endpoint. expected_category is the label a human would assign by hand — not generated by the classifier itself. See docs/EVALS.md for how this is meant to be used.

examples.title: App crashes when uploading a photo
examples.description: Every time I try to upload a profile photo larger than 2MB, the app force-closes immediately.

examples.title: Login button does nothing on Safari
examples.description: Clicking 'Log In' on Safari 17 does nothing — no error, no redirect. Works fine on Chrome.

examples.title: Duplicate charges on invoice #4482
examples.description: I was charged twice for the same subscription renewal this month, both showing invoice #4482.

examples.title: Search returns zero results for exact matches
examples.description: Searching for the exact product name 'Widget Pro 3000' returns no results, even though the product exists in the catalog.

examples.title: Dark mode toggle resets on every page reload
examples.description: I enable dark mode, refresh the page, and it reverts to light mode every single time.

examples.title: Export to CSV produces corrupted file
examples.description: When I export my report to CSV, the downloaded file won't open in Excel — it says the file format is invalid.

examples.title: Add bulk delete for old tickets
examples.description: It would save a lot of time if we could select multiple tickets and delete them all at once instead of one by one.

examples.title: Support for two-factor authentication
examples.description: Please add 2FA support (TOTP or SMS) — our security team requires it before we can roll this out company-wide.

examples.title: Ability to schedule reports in advance
examples.description: Would love to schedule a report to auto-generate and email every Monday morning instead of running it manually.

examples.title: Dark mode for the mobile app
examples.description: The web app has dark mode, but the mobile app doesn't. Any plans to add it?

examples.title: Keyboard shortcuts for common actions
examples.description: Power users would benefit a lot from keyboard shortcuts for archive, delete, and reply.

examples.title: Integrate with Slack for notifications
examples.description: We'd like ticket updates to post to a Slack channel automatically instead of checking email.

examples.title: API docs missing rate limit info
examples.description: The API reference doesn't mention what the rate limits are for the /orders endpoint, so we keep hitting 429s unexpectedly.

examples.title: Setup guide references a deprecated command
examples.description: The 'Getting Started' guide tells you to run 'npm run setup', but that script was removed two versions ago.

examples.title: Broken link in the changelog
examples.description: The link to 'migration guide' in the v3.0 changelog entry returns a 404.

examples.title: Unclear which plan includes SSO
examples.description: The pricing page doesn't clearly state which tier includes single sign-on — I had to contact support to find out.

examples.title: Code example in webhook docs doesn't match actual payload
examples.description: The sample JSON payload shown for the 'order.created' webhook is missing the 'customer_id' field that actually gets sent.

examples.title: No documentation for the new bulk import endpoint
examples.description: The bulk import API was released last week but there's nothing about it on the docs site yet.

examples.title: Do you offer nonprofit discounts?
examples.description: We're a registered nonprofit — is there a discount program we could apply for?

examples.title: How do I cancel my subscription?
examples.description: I want to cancel but can't find the option anywhere in account settings.

examples.title: Can I get an invoice with our company's VAT number?
examples.description: For accounting purposes we need invoices to include our VAT number. Is this possible?

examples.title: What's your data retention policy?
examples.description: Before we onboard, our compliance team wants to know how long you retain user data after account deletion.

examples.title: Question about upgrading from Team to Enterprise
examples.description: We're growing past our Team plan limits — what's involved in upgrading to Enterprise, and is there a migration cost?

examples.title: App feels slow lately
examples.description: Not sure if this is just me, but everything in the dashboard has felt sluggish over the past week.
examples.notes: Reads as a vague complaint, but 'feels sluggish' describes degraded behavior, not a request or a docs issue — leaning bug over other. A reasonable grader might also accept 'other' given the total lack of reproduction steps.

examples.title: Notifications arrive way too late to be useful
examples.description: By the time I get a push notification about a new message, it's often 10+ minutes after it was sent. Is this expected?
examples.notes: Phrased as a question ('is this expected?'), which pulls toward 'other', but the substance is a concrete performance regression in an existing feature — bug.

examples.title: Feature working differently than documented
examples.description: The docs say the export button supports PDF, but when I click it, only CSV is offered.
examples.notes: Could reasonably be filed as 'bug' (the feature doesn't do what it should) or 'documentation' (the docs promise something that isn't true). Gold label picks documentation since the fix here is correcting the docs, not necessarily the code — but this is a genuinely defensible 50/50 case, good for testing rubric partial credit.

examples.title: Several problems after the latest update
examples.description: Since updating to v4.2: (1) the app crashes when I open settings, (2) I can't find the export option anymore, and (3) could you also add a way to bulk-tag items? Thanks!
examples.notes: Bundles a crash (bug), a possibly-relocated feature (other/documentation), and a feature request in one ticket. Gold label follows real-world triage: classify by the most severe issue (the crash) since that's what would actually get escalated first.

examples.title: It's broken
examples.description: Please fix, this is broken.
examples.notes: Minimal information, but 'broken'/'fix' explicitly signal malfunctioning behavior rather than a request or inquiry. Expect low classifier confidence to be acceptable here even if the category is right.

examples.title: Thanks!
examples.description: Just wanted to say the new update is great, thank you!
examples.notes: Pure positive feedback, no actionable request at all — tests whether the classifier defaults sensibly to 'other' instead of forcing it into bug/feature-request/documentation.

examples.title: Question
examples.description: How does billing work?
examples.notes: Extremely short, single-line ticket — tests behavior on minimal input rather than a genuinely ambiguous one.
